title: Prism
metaDescription: 116 emerald-cut diamonds · 35.19 carats total · mosaic grid bracelet. A continuous diamond surface that flexes with the wrist. Bez Ambar, Los Angeles.
copy: 116 emerald-cut diamonds, each one chosen, each one placed — assembled into a surface that moves like water and catches light like a mirror. The emerald cut was never meant for softness. It's the most honest cut in diamonds: open table, long lines, nowhere to hide. At 35.19 carats across a single bracelet, it doesn't hide anything.

specs.label: Stones
specs.body: 116 emerald-cut diamonds · 35.19 carats total. Large stones anchor the center rows; smaller stones tile the edges. Every stone selected for its step-cut clarity and line.

specs.label: Setting
specs.body: Mosaic grid — emerald cuts set stone-to-stone across the full face of the bracelet. The result is a continuous diamond surface: a textile of light that flexes with the wrist.

specs.label: Availability
specs.body: On hand. Available immediately by private inquiry.

specs.label: More Details
specs.body: Designed and made in Los Angeles. Available by private appointment.
